name: apt-repository devcontainer
postCreateCommand: bash .devcontainer/setup.sh && if [ -f /tmp/host_gitconfig ]; then rm -f /home/vscode/.gitconfig ; cp /tmp/host_gitconfig /home/vscode/.gitconfig && sed -i 's|${localEnv:HOME}/.ssh|/home/vscode/.ssh|g' /home/vscode/.gitconfig ; fi && if [ -f /home/vscode/.ssh/id_rsa ]; then chmod 600 /home/vscode/.ssh/id_rsa ; fi && if [ -f /home/vscode/.ssh/id_ed25519 ]; then chmod 600 /home/vscode/.ssh/id_ed25519 ; fi && sudo mandb || true
